quiz.q: What happens to running goroutines when main returns?
options: they keep running in the background
the program exits and they are stopped
quiz.why: Program execution ends when main returns. Use a WaitGroup or channels to wait.

options: concurrency is structure (dealing with many things); parallelism is simultaneous execution
parallelism needs goroutines; concurrency needs threads
quiz.why: Concurrent code CAN run in parallel on multiple cores, but doesn't have to.

quiz.q: How do you detect a race condition?
quiz.why: go run -race / go test -race instruments memory accesses.
If Add runs inside the goroutine, Wait might return before Add happens.

quiz.q: Which is NOT a way to fix a data race on a counter?
quiz.why: Gosched only yields the processor. It synchronizes nothing.
